'''Vardin''' was a long-abandoned settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Vardin, a city in ruins, was one of the planet's major [[City/Legends|cities]]. [[Dreshdae]] and [[Kaniset]] were among its rivals in size.
